title: wiBOOt
description: A bundle of spooky mods and resource packs to enchance the halloween spirit
body:
# wi**BOO**t Modpack!

## What does this modpack do?
This modpack adds a bunch of different (hopefully) scary mods and resources that should make your minecraft experience as creepy as possible! It adds things such as a creepier ambience, scary entities and eerie biomes.

## Why should you download?
This modpack is specifically aimed towards the wi**BOO**t server, a halloween server ran through October on the Wibbyt community server, and by downloading this modpack you can instantly take part of an amazing community on a fun (but spooky) server with lots of content. You can of course also download this modpack to play on your own!


**The server ip will automatically be included in the server list when installed, join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/nKXXfKR9Dq) for more info.**
